lines.en: label soccer5:
scene sky
I kick some dirt up as I make my way across the soccer field first thing in the morning.
lines.zh: 一大早穿过足球场时，我踢起些许尘土。

lines.en: Why I've decided to take my chances on conversing with the most energetic creature I have ever encountered less than an hour after waking up? I have no idea.
lines.zh: 我为什么决定在起床不到一小时后就跑去和我见过的精力最旺盛的生物搭话？我也不知道。

lines.en: But I'm here now, so...I guess that means I should be making the best of it.
lines.zh: 但我都已经来了，所以……我想这意味着我应该好好利用一下。

lines.en: That aside, I'm here relatively early today. So chances are I'll have some time to kill before Miku and the others shows up.
lines.zh: 话说回来，我今天来得相当早。所以在 Miku 和其他人出现之前，我大概有些时间要打发。

lines.en: I'm not exactly excited to spend this surplus of time alone, but I guess it will give me some time to think over whether I want to actually {i}coach{/i} this team or not.
lines.zh: 我并不怎么期待独自消磨这段多出来的时间，但我想这正好让我有时间考虑一下，是否真的要{i}执教{/i}这支队伍。

lines.en: On one hand, doing that would probably mean waking up earlier a lot more often...and that doesn't sound fun at all.
lines.zh: 一方面，那大概意味着要经常起得更早……而这一点都不好玩。

lines.en: But on the other hand, it may enable me to seduce a congregation of tomboys- and that sounds significantly more interesting.
lines.zh: 但另一方面，它也许能让我勾引一群假小子——听上去就有意思多了。

lines.en: You know, maybe it's good that I came a little early? At least now I can-
lines.zh: 你知道吗，也许我来早一点是件好事？至少现在我可以——

lines.en: : Heya! Sensei! Over here!
lines.zh: : 嘿呀！Sensei！这边！

lines.en: At least now I can forget I ever thought that and get locked into a conversation with Miku.
lines.zh: 至少现在我可以忘掉自己刚才那个念头，然后被 Miku 缠着聊上天。

lines.en: scene soccerfive1
: Mornin', Sensei! Come to watch me practice again?
lines.zh: : 早上好，Sensei！又来看我训练啦？

lines.en: : Looks that way. And for a second, I thought I may have beaten you here.
lines.zh: : 看起来是的。有一瞬间我还以为我能比你先到呢。

lines.en: scene soccerfive2
: Ha! You're gonna need a lot of practice if you ever expect to beat me here. Not even rain or snow can stop Miku Maruyama from bein' the first one to practice every morning.
lines.zh: : 哈！想比我先到，你还得多练练呢。哪怕是刮风下雪，也拦不住 Miku Maruyama 每天早上第一个来训练。

lines.en: : Well I'm glad that it's always sunny in Kumon-mi because I'm beginning to believe you might freeze to death if it wasn't.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很庆幸 Kumon-mi 永远阳光灿烂，不然我开始怀疑你会冻死。

lines.en: scene soccerfive3
: Hey, yeah. That is kinda weird, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 嘿，是啊。那确实有点怪，不是吗？

lines.en: : You tell me. I've only been here for [totaldays] days so it's not like it's {i}that{/i} weird for me just yet.
lines.zh: : 你告诉我啊。我到这里才 [totaldays] 天，所以对我来说还不{i}至于{/i}那么奇怪。

lines.en: : The heck is that supposed to mean? You some kinda alien or robot the government sent over?
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思？你是政府派来的外星人还是机器人？

lines.en: : Oh! Or maybe you're not the real Sensei at all and this is one of those body swap thingies! Like in that one movie with all the lens flares!
lines.zh: : 哦！或者你根本不是真正的 Sensei，这是那种身体互换的戏码！就像那部到处都是镜头光晕的电影一样！

lines.en: : I have absolutely no idea what you're talking about, but I feel like that second one has a chance to be true.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么，但我觉得第二种有可能是真的。

lines.en: scene soccerfive1
: Just don't let Makoto know. She likes the normal Sensei a lot and I don't know how she'd handle some country girl bein' the one inside of you all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 不过别让 Makoto 知道。她很喜欢那个正常的 Sensei，我不知道如果她突然发现你身体里是个乡下姑娘，会作何反应。

lines.en: : I'd much prefer to be inside of the country girl in that scenario.
lines.zh: : 真要那样的话，我倒更想进到那个乡下姑娘身体里去。

lines.en: : You would be! That's how body swaps work. You'd be inside of her and she'd be inside of you.
lines.zh: : 你本来就会在她身体里啊！身体互换就是这么回事。你在她里面，她在你里面。

lines.en: : Well, that just sounds difficult and painful. But anyway, where is everybody else right now?
lines.zh: : 那听起来又麻烦又痛苦。不过话说回来，其他人现在都在哪儿？

lines.en: : Idunno. Probably still wakin' up or somethin'.
lines.zh: : 不知道。大概还在起床什么的吧。

lines.en: : You’re the captain, aren’t you? Shouldn’t they get here whenever you show up?
lines.zh: : 你不是队长吗？他们不该是你一到就到吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I guess so? I ain't holdin' it against anybody if they don't wanna be as early as me, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧？不过要是有人不想跟我一样早，我也不会怪他们。

lines.en: : Here's hoping that doesn't come around to bite you in the ass one day.
lines.zh: : 只希望这别有朝一日反过来咬你一口。

lines.en: scene soccerfive4
: Ain't much to bite in the first place.
lines.zh: : 本来也没什么可咬的。

lines.en: : I can't tell if that silence means you want me to compliment your ass or not.
lines.zh: : 我搞不清这份沉默是意味着你想让我夸你的屁股，还是不想。

lines.en: scene soccerfive2
: Sensei, if there's anything I've learned from Netflix documentaries, is that it's probably best to never compliment a schoolgirl's butt.
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果说我从 Netflix 纪录片里学到了什么，那就是最好永远别夸女学生的屁股。

lines.en: : What an extremely specific thing to be the {i}one{/i} piece of information you leeched from documentaries.
lines.zh: : 你从纪录片里{i}唯一{/i}吸收到的一条信息，还真是具体得离谱。

lines.en: scene soccerfive5
: I kinda only pay attention for the first ten minutes or so anyway, so it ain't like that info has anywhere to go.
lines.zh: : 反正我也只在前十分钟左右认真看，所以那些信息也没别的地方可去。

lines.en: : 'Sides, my brain's filled to the brim with soccer stuff so there ain't even room for all that smart person mumbo jumbo.
lines.zh: : 再说，我脑子里塞满了足球的事，连那些聪明人的鬼话都装不下了。

lines.en: : I'm sure you could be plenty smart if you applied yourself, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，只要你肯用心，你也可以很聪明的，Miku。

lines.en: scene soccerfive6
: Applied where?
lines.zh: : 用在哪儿？

lines.en: : Okay, nevermind.
lines.zh: : 好吧，当我没说。

lines.en: : I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。

lines.en: : You know what? Why don't we talk about something you do understand. Like...soccer.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我们不如聊点你懂的东西吧。比如……足球。

lines.en: : Why exactly do you want me to be your coach again?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么想让我当你们的教练来着？

lines.en: : Because the last one got knocked up and we're gonna get disbanded if we don't find a new one.
lines.zh: : 因为上一个教练怀孕了，我们要是找不到新的，就会被解散。

lines.en: : So...it doesn't have to be me. It can be anyone?
lines.zh: : 所以……不一定非得是我。谁都行？

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah.
lines.zh: : 基本上，是啊。

lines.en: : You're not very good at selling things, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你真不擅长推销啊，Miku。

lines.en: scene soccerfive7
: Selling?! I gotta {i}pay{/i} you now?!
lines.zh: : 推销？！我现在还得{i}付钱{/i}给你？！

lines.en: : That...That would be {i}buying,{/i} wouldn't it?
lines.zh: : 那……那应该叫{i}买{/i}吧？

lines.en: : I don't friggin' know! I've been lost since you started talkin' about butts!
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道！从你开始聊屁股我就彻底懵了！

lines.en: : I will do my best to resist bringing them up in the future, but I will also inform you now that I will likely fail.
lines.zh: : 我会尽量以后不再提这个话题，但我现在就把话说清楚——我很可能会失败。

lines.en: : So...wait, are you gonna be the coach or not?
lines.zh: : 那……等等，你到底要不要当教练？

lines.en: : I'm still not sure. I don't know the first thing about soccer. Hell, I barely even remember all the names of my students. There's no way I can memorize the entire team.
lines.zh: : 我还不确定。我对足球一窍不通。见鬼，我连自己学生的名字都记不全。我怎么可能记住整支队伍。

lines.en: scene soccerfive1
: Really? I thought learnin’ names that quick was like a special ability all teachers were just born with.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我还以为快速记住名字是老师们天生就有的特殊能力呢。

lines.en: : Well, first off, we aren’t born as-
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先，我们又不是生下来就——

lines.en: : Well...{i}most{/i} people aren't born as teachers.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}大多数{/i}人不是生下来就是老师。

lines.en: : But even the ones that {i}are{/i} still have to practice memorizing names.
lines.zh: : 但就算是{i}天生{/i}当老师的人，也得练习记名字。

lines.en: : Really? Then...do you have any special talents at all, Sensei? It doesn't have to just be boring teaching stuff. Could be anything.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那……Sensei 你有什么特长吗？不一定是无聊的教学那种，什么都行。

lines.en: : I...guess I'm good with my hands?
lines.zh: : 我……大概手上功夫还不错？

lines.en: scene soccerfive7
: What do you mean? Like givin' massages or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？比如会按摩之类的？

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 嗯。就当是吧。

lines.en: scene soccerfive8
: Well, that’s just one more reason for you to be coach, then!
lines.zh: : 那这就是你该当教练的又一个理由了！

lines.en: : Never underestimate the value of a good massage on an athlete’s muscles!
lines.zh: : 千万别低估一次舒服的按摩对运动员肌肉的价值！

lines.en: : Plus, think of all the girls you’d get to rub without ever seemin' like a weirdo!
lines.zh: : 再说，想想你能给多少女生按摩，还一点都不像个变态！

lines.en: : There is no possible way things would work out that easily.
lines.zh: : 事情绝不可能那么顺利。

lines.en: : Sure it would! Silence 'em all with those magic hands of yours!
lines.zh: : 当然会！用你那双魔术手让她们全都安静下来！

lines.en: : Can I just...give the massages without doing the coaching thing?
lines.zh: : 我能……只做按摩，不带训练吗？

lines.en: scene soccerfive7
: That might be kinda hard explainin’ to everybody...
lines.zh: : 那要跟所有人解释起来可能有点难……

lines.en: : Especially on account of most of ‘em not havin’ any experience with boys and stuff.
lines.zh: : 尤其是她们大多都没什么和男孩子打交道的经验。

lines.en: : Are you implying that you {i}do{/i} have experience with boys, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示你{i}确实{/i}有和男孩子打交道的经验吗，Miku？

lines.en: scene soccerfive9
: Huh?
: Me?
: The heck are you talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 你到底在说什么啊？

lines.en: : Have you {i}seen{/i} me? I’m built like a ten year old boy.
lines.zh: : 你{i}见过{/i}我吧？我这身材跟十岁小男孩似的。

lines.en: : Goin’ on a date with Miku Maruyama would be like...askin’ out your little brother.
lines.zh: : 和 Miku Maruyama 约会，大概就像……约自己的弟弟出去一样。

lines.en: scene soccerfive1
: I don't care, though! I don’t really have time for stuff like that anyways. Gotta focus on soccer and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过我不在乎！反正我也没时间搞那些。得专注在足球什么的上面。

lines.en: scene soccerfive2
: Plus! My growth spurt should be comin’ any day now! Don’t be surprised if I wind up even bustier than Futaba this time next year!
lines.zh: : 而且！我的猛长期随时都会来！明年这个时候我要是变得比 Futaba 还大，你可别惊讶！

lines.en: I am trying to picture that and I...can't really see how it would work.
lines.zh: 我试图想象那个画面，可我……实在想象不出那怎么可能。

lines.en: : Maybe...aim for someone closer to Rin's size if you're going to have goals like that. I don't know if Futaba is at a level you'll ever be able to reach.
lines.zh: : 要定这种目标的话，也许……瞄准离 Rin 身材更近一点的人比较好。我不确定 Futaba 是你能够到的水平。

lines.en: : She’s honestly kind of unreal for someone your age.
lines.zh: : 说实话，就你这个年纪而言，她有点不真实。

lines.en: scene soccerfive6r
: Right?! You could knock over an ice cream truck with those puppies!
lines.zh: : 就是说啊！那对家伙能撞翻一辆冰淇淋车！

lines.en: : But...why would you-
lines.zh: : 可是……你为什么——

lines.en: scene soccerfive1
: You just could, okay? And hey, why are you even here so early?
lines.zh: : 就是能，行了吧？话说回来，你今天怎么来得这么早？

lines.en: : We started talkin’ about body swaps and stuff right away so I never found out. You have some kinda...teacher meeting or something?
lines.zh: : 我们一上来就聊身体互换什么的，所以我一直没问。你是有那种……教师会议什么的吗？

lines.en: : Maybe I was just really excited to see you?
lines.zh: : 也许我只是真的很想见你呢？

lines.en: : Yeah, I ain't buyin' that. What's the real reason?
lines.zh: : 是吗，我可不信。真正的原因是什么？

lines.en: : No real reason, I guess. Thought about heading over to the cafe beforehand, but that...never happened.
lines.zh: : 大概没什么特别的原因。本来想先去趟咖啡馆的，但……没去成。

lines.en: : The one Rin works at? Makoto loves that place.
lines.zh: : Rin 打工的那家？Makoto 超喜欢那家店。

lines.en: : She always gets this weird drink with caramel in the name.
lines.zh: : 她总是点一种名字里带焦糖的怪饮料。

lines.en: : It’s like a caramel marshmallow or something.
lines.zh: : 好像是什么焦糖棉花糖之类的。

lines.en: : I think that would be a...caramel macchiato?
lines.zh: : 那应该是……焦糖玛奇朵吧？

lines.en: : I guess that drink fits her, though. Sweet and mildly complicated.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得那饮料挺配她的。甜，还稍微有点复杂。

lines.en: scene soccerfive2
: And totally hot, right?
lines.zh: : 而且超级火辣，对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Right?{/i}
: Miku, do you have a crush on Makoto?
lines.zh: : Miku，你喜欢 Makoto 吗？

lines.en: scene soccerfive6r
: What?! No!
lines.zh: : 什么？！才没有！

lines.en: : She just told me she’d buy me lunch if I said nice stuff about her to you. I didn't mean to make it sound like I was tryin' to score with her!
lines.zh: : 她只是说，如果我在你面前说她好话，她就请我吃午饭。我不是故意说得好像我想追她似的！

lines.en: : Makoto is...paying you to 'talk her up' to me?
lines.zh: : Makoto 是……花钱雇你在我面前「说她好话」？

lines.en: scene soccerfive2
: You bet! And for the low, low price of 500 yen, I can deliver a message for you as well!
lines.zh: : 当然！而且只要区区 500 日元，我也能帮你传个话！

lines.en: : Are you some sort of used car salesman now? Because I thought we figured out that selling things wasn't right for you.
lines.zh: : 你现在改行卖二手车了？我以为我们已经搞清楚你不适合推销了。

lines.en: scene soccerfive4
: With my grades, I might have to be.
lines.zh: : 就我这成绩，说不定真得干这行。

lines.en: : You don’t have to take any sort of fancy test to become a car salesman do you?
lines.zh: : 当汽车销售员应该不用考什么高级的试吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think so?...
lines.zh: : 应该不用吧？……

lines.en: : But is that something you really want to do?
lines.zh: : 可那真是你想做的事吗？

lines.en: scene soccerfive5
: I don't know. I haven’t really thought about the future like that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我还没认真想过未来这回事。

lines.en: : You haven’t? I was under the impression you just wanted to be a soccer player or something.
lines.zh: : 你没想过？我还以为你一心想当足球运动员什么的。

lines.en: scene soccerfive1
: I mean, that’d be awesome, yeah. But even someone as good as me isn’t a sure shot to make the Olympic team...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那当然很棒啦。但就算是像我这么厉害的人，也不一定能进奥运代表队……

lines.en: : Or...any sort of professional team, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 或者……说白了，任何一支职业球队。

lines.en: : I always hear people sayin’ stuff like “Miku! You need a backup plan! What if your leg snaps in half or your arm gets bitten off by a shark!”
lines.zh: : 我总是听到别人说什么「Miku！你得有个备选方案！万一你的腿断成两截，或者胳膊被鲨鱼咬掉了怎么办！」

lines.en: : And I’m just over here like, “Sharks aren’t even real!”
lines.zh: : 而我就像在想，「鲨鱼根本不存在吧！」

lines.en: : And then Makoto is all like “What are you talking about?! Of course they are!”
lines.zh: : 然后 Makoto 就会说「你在说什么？！当然是存在的啊！」

lines.en: : And so I’m all like “You’re not my mom, Makoto! Gimme my 500 yen for tellin’ Sensei you’re a caramel marshmallow!”
lines.zh: : 然后我就说「你又不是我妈，Makoto！把我告诉 Sensei 你是焦糖棉花糖的 500 日元给我！」

lines.en: : Miku, I think you need to sleep more.
lines.zh: : Miku，我觉得你需要多睡点觉。

lines.en: scene soccerfive2
: Heheh...I’m just pullin’ your leg this time.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……这次我是开玩笑的啦。

lines.en: : I’m sure I'll be fine with whatever happens to me after high school.
lines.zh: : 不管高中毕业以后发生什么，我肯定都能过得去的。

lines.en: scene soccerfive9r
: Yeah, I might not make it as a soccer player or used car salesman or whatever-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我可能当不成足球运动员，也当不成二手车销售员，管他呢——

lines.en: : But as long as I can find somethin’ that makes me happy, that’s all that matters, right?
lines.zh: : 但只要我能找到让我开心的事，那就够了，对吧？

lines.en: scene soccerfive11
: Oh! Here come the other girls!
lines.zh: : 哦！其他女生来啦！

lines.en: : Hey! I'm over here with our future coach!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我和我们未来的教练在这儿！

lines.en: : Kirin! Make sure you wear your shin guards this time! If your sister kicks you in the leg again, don’t come cryin’ to me!
lines.zh: : Kirin！这次记得戴护腿板！要是你姐再踢你的腿，别跑来跟我哭！

lines.en: scene soccerfive1
: Sorry to break up our meeting, but I’ve gotta get to practicin’ for real now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉要打断我们的会谈，不过 Sensei，我得开始正式训练了。

lines.en: : But it was fun talkin’ to you and stuff! Keep thinkin’ about that coachin’ offer if you ever want to rub some [teenage]legs!
lines.zh: : 但和你聊天很开心什么的！要是你想摸摸[teenage]的腿，就继续考虑那个当教练的提议吧！

lines.en: : Or just drop by whenever you want to hang out! So long as I'm not practicin', I mean.
lines.zh: : 或者你随时过来玩也行！我是说只要我不在训练。

lines.en: scene black
Miku gets up and sprints over to the rest of her team, jumping into the arms of a taller looking girl before I even have a chance to respond.
lines.zh: Miku 站起身，朝队伍其他人冲刺过去，我还没来得及回答，她就跳进了一个个子更高的女孩怀里。

lines.en: I wonder what she meant by finding ‘something that makes her happy...’
lines.zh: 我在想她说的「找到让她开心的事」到底是什么意思……

lines.en: I'm sure she's not the only person who hasn't been thinking that much about the future...but she should probably have at least {i}some{/i} sort of idea and-
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，不是只有她一个人没怎么想过未来……但她至少应该{i}有{/i}点想法才对，而且——

lines.en: My thoughts of Miku's future are interrupted by a stampede of exposed thighs and form fitting spandex.
lines.zh: 我对 Miku 未来的思绪，被一大群裸露的大腿和紧身氨纶打断了。

lines.en: $ soccer5 = True
$ miku_love += 1
{i}Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
